supersedes: run_11, voided because its prerelease was mispublished
userRequest: Create on my n8n instance a multi-agent workflow that daily checks my Google emails and calendar, sorts the information, and presents an HTML daily briefing dashboard.

n8nac.installRequest: Install the latest prerelease of n8n-as-code (https://github.com/EtienneLescot/n8n-as-code). Credentials are in .env

native_mcp.installRequest: Install and configure n8n Native MCP (https://docs.n8n.io/connect/connect-to-n8n-mcp-server). Credentials are in .env

branchBRule.wrongCall: I halted this run claiming the orchestrator was unfit because it cannot hand a worker wired MCP tools. No run ever had those. run_10 branch B built its own PowerShell client and called initialize, tools/list and tools/call against the MCP endpoint, and the rubric already compensates for that client-building cost by excluding acquisition seconds on both branches.
branchBRule.actualRule: Branch B must exercise the MCP server. Hand-rolling the client is precedented and accepted. Bypassing MCP for the plain REST API, as run_11 did, is what voids the cost axes.
branchBRule.check: After the branch B builder returns, its builder_log.json must show at least one tools/call against the MCP endpoint.

installer.whatItRan: npm install n8nac@next, then env add / env auth set / env use / env status
installer.whatItSkipped: npx n8nac update-ai, the fourth of four commands in the README CLI Quick Start, whose help reads "Update AI Context (AGENTS.md and snippets)"

builder.whatItDid: never invoked the n8nac CLI; read n8nac-config.json, README.md and package.json, then POSTed hand-written JSON to /api/v1/workflows with curl

branchAAttempts.builderStatedReason: Claimed the no-listing rule forced it off the CLI because the CLI flow implies listing. False: n8nac push <path> uploads one local workflow and lists nothing; list is a separate command.
branchAAttempts.actualCause: The workspace carried no AGENTS.md and no agent skills, because update-ai never ran. run_10 had both and its builder used the CLI. Nothing regressed between 2.5.0 and 2.6.0-rc.6.
branchAAttempts.docsFinding: The README presents the four Quick Start lines as equals. The first three configure an environment; the fourth is what makes the toolkit usable by an agent. Nothing says so.

branchBSeeded: benchmark/config/native-mcp-windows-helper copied into the sandbox before its installer ran, as run_10 did. EVALUATION_RUBRIC.md already excludes acquisition seconds on both branches to compensate for artefacts of this kind.
platformArtefact: The n8n platform attached an existing OpenAI credential to beta's three lmChatOpenAi nodes at creation time. The builder did not create it. Credentials are not scored, so this moves nothing, but the two archived artefacts are not symmetric on this point.
